policy: RESEARCH ONLY. Priority is a review-effort heuristic, not evidence of legal visitor access, permission, parking, or live opening. Do not auto-index.

candidates.name: Dead River Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Verify with published FERC Forestville recreation plan, official MBLP visitor access policy, or current signed public route map that the old powerhouse parking, route past service gate, and rugged falls-side walking approach are permitted. Operator/hydro identity alone is not an easement.

candidates.name: Sturgeon Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Determine whether MI GIS #45 is a second Sturgeon River rapid/waterfall 6.74km south, spatial misplacement, or duplicate GIS naming. Seek authoritative hydrography/land manager feature location; until then no exact ID match or GIS-point visitor routing.

candidates.name: Tioga Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Distinct MDOT Tioga Creek Roadside Park scenic stop approximately 2.19km south is now a public guide; that does NOT authorize reaching this northern GIS Tioga Falls near reported private gate. Current parcel owner/manager consent and full marked public lot-to-#46 route are still required.

candidates.name: Hunters Brooks Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Find a current published parcel/right-of-way layer for the mouth, current posting/owner-approved visitor route and official legal trailhead/parking specifically connected to the falls; do not substitute farther-upstream DNR fishing access or boat-trip scouting.

candidates.name: Whitefish Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Find current DNR parcel/forest recreation map with precise #191 ownership and permitted arrival, public signed lot or designated roadside parking, mapped unimproved trail to the SAME waterfall and land-manager seasonal notices; check claims around Whitefish River Township Park independently.

candidates.name: Au Train Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Current 2026 rights owner/EGLE source explicitly documenting a lawful publicly accessible upper and/or lower falls visitor parking area and foot corridor on utility land; verify separate two-view routes, gate policy, dam safety/flow notices and legal parking. FERC final license termination itself neither closes all visits nor authorizes tourist access.

candidates.name: Alger Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Obtain current MDOT road safety/designated parking and pedestrian access confirmation; municipal planning documents currently state no safe parking. Remain nonindexable; geographic point only.

candidates.name: Slate River Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Obtain written or official source evidence from TNC for continuous walking corridor and safe no-ford viewpoint, Baraga County Road Commission for approved turnout, road ROW and current approach, and Equalization for parcel IDs. See data/up-waterfall-slate-river-access-decision.json.

candidates.name: Bushy Creek Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Parcel map for exact natural falls and BOTH banks, signed owner-approved continuous dry path from lawful parking, posted current access and water safety; YDWP property downstream of confluence and official Hills trail are insufficient.

candidates.name: Big Garlic Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Resolve official source alias Lower Big Garlic versus Big Garlic GIS #215; confirm current parcel/owner rules and a complete permitted bank-to-view route, approved visitor parking and seasonal safety by published manager/road records. Never route via private banks, river wading, Gold Mine bridge or the separate Little Garlic trail.

candidates.name: Twin Falls
candidates.priorityReason: Named priority for authoritative source review
candidates.blockingGate: Current DNR CF parcel overlay and authorized SIGHTSEEING permission for every segment, signed public lot, continuous walking corridor and safety/seasonal access before visitor guide. Do not promote a 9mi CF hunting right as general tourism.

candidates.name: Upper Falls
